preferred_route: Pinned isolated R process invoking the maintained native core, subject to separate runtime admission
alias_relation: Native core of inherited:grf; distinct integration route, same engine lineage

target_and_exclusions.target: E[Y(1)-Y(0)] in the declared customer population, estimated by all-sample AIPW scores; not mean fitted CATE.
target_and_exclusions.law: Complete independent customer rows; one binary action, one fixed scalar outcome and horizon.
target_and_exclusions.assumption_status: Declared premises; neither syntax nor fitting verifies them.

initial_options.seed: Required integer, recorded; no default random draw

target_and_exclusions.nuisance: Retain R OOB nuisance path; optional declared known randomized propensity only. Supplied fitted nuisances need a separately qualified provenance/split profile.
excluded: Weights or clusters in initial profile
External fitted nuisance vectors in initial profile
target_and_exclusions.extension: Independent-cluster all-sample AIPW design retains cluster units and target weights; no current admission or few-cluster coverage.

failure_contract.unavailable: Current state: engine/dependency/admission receipt absent; no numeric result.
failure_contract.unsupported: Recognized query outside profile; explain sampling/target mismatch and reviewed alternative.
failure_contract.refused: Support or identification prerequisites fail under declared profile; retain diagnostics and target.
failure_contract.not_identified: Only with an audited identification failure; inability of adapter is not proof.
failure_contract.failed: Nonfinite result, corrupt model, subprocess error, timeout or resource failure; no partial numeric estimate.
failure_contract.computed: Only admitted runtime result with original context and units, scalar AIPW target, provenance; uncertainty no stronger than bound evidence.
failure_contract.sets: Preserve unknown/empty/disconnected/unbounded sets from applicable methods; this forest route cannot fabricate a finite interval for them.

environment_and_rights.declared_build: R >=3.5.0; C++17; GNU make; LinkingTo Rcpp/RcppEigen; imports DiceKriging,lmtest,Matrix,methods,Rcpp,sandwich; versions locked at admission.
environment_and_rights.native_build: Inspected CMake builds an executable with src and test sources; shared-library ABI remains unqualified.
environment_and_rights.environment: Record source/binary/compiler/flags/R/dependency/thread/RNG/global-option hashes and versions; declarations do not prove installed compatibility.
environment_and_rights.rights: DESCRIPTION GPL-3; inspected source headers GPL-3-or-later; preserve file and dependency terms, review distribution obligations before release.
environment_and_rights.isolation: One worker per local R process; native global runtime_context writes require separate shared-embedding concurrency review.
environment_and_rights.faults: Parent-enforced wall/memory/output budget, bounded logs, atomic complete publication. No mid-tree resume; immutable replay only. Cross-environment bitwise equality unclaimed.

maintenance_evidence: Dated pinned commit, named maintainer and tracker, source test/build machinery; no support SLA or installed test result.
cost_evidence: No measured R/native workload comparison; direct embedding transfers statistical and lifetime ownership without established savings.
owner_obligations: Freeze complete source/dependencies/rights and a local runtime environment.
Implement profile validator and request/result conversions with unavailable/unsupported/refusal/fault paths.
Compare actual R execution with exact fixtures and source-correct AIPW/variance oracle; validate serialization/reload, coordinates and units.
If needed implement native route and match R preprocessing, options, predictions and aggregation; include lifetime and failure trials.
Profile full workflow; prospectively register generated-data study for any coverage/performance claim.
Run registered study retaining failed requests; report scoped results and conditional next experiment.
revisit_trigger: Concrete host constraint or measured identical-workload benefit, plus complete environment/rights and native/R statistical/lifetime/reload/failure parity evidence.
